response: To create a single, consistent source of key business information.

query: A data analyst has started at a small organization where the previous data analyst left but did not leave documentation behind. They begin looking at certain data that was used for dimension data, not transactional data. It also does not seem to change very frequently. What is the data analyst most likely looking at?
response: Master data

query: As a data analyst, you have finished drafting a wireframe for a new HR dashboard. You review your sketch with several key stakeholders. They express confusion about how to access specific sections of the dashboard and mention that some important filters are hard to find in your layout. What should you do next to effectively apply best practices in mockup and wireframing?
response: Revise your wireframe to improve navigation and placement of filters, then ask stakeholders for further feedback on the updated design.

query: Which of the following is the BEST example of an effective page title for a dashboard page that displays sales trends for product categories?
response: Product Category Sales Trends

query: You are designing a new company annual report that will include several pages of detailed financial analysis, as well as easy-to-read charts and summary visuals. The report will be distributed both as a printed booklet and a downloadable PDF. As you choose your font styles, you want to maximize readability and professionalism for both text narratives and visual elements such as chart titles and labels. Which of the following font strategies should you apply for the BEST results?
response: Use a serif font for the narrative text and a sans serif font for the chart titles and labels.

query: A marketing analyst wants to save the departments' time by establishing a standardized color scheme for other departments to use in presentations. Assuming no existing style guide, which of the following will help them? (Select all that apply.)
response: Theme,Template,Design guidelines

query: You are preparing a sales dashboard that will be viewed by regional managers via their smartphones during weekly meetings. Some dashboards may also be printed as PDFs for executive review. Which of the following is the BEST approach when selecting fonts and layout for your dashboard?
response: Choose a font that is clear and readable across both web and print, use a layout optimized for smaller screen sizes, and ensure adequate spacing to enhance readability on mobile devices.

query: You are the lead analyst for a hospital's reporting team. Hospital administrators ask you to provide weekly reports tracking patient wait times, staff efficiency, and bed occupancy to help them manage daily operations. Additionally, the hospital must submit monthly reports detailing patient safety incidents and staff training attendance to comply with national healthcare regulations. You are tasked with setting up an appropriate reporting process to meet both needs. Which course of action BEST applies the requirements for both operational and compliance reporting in this context?
response: Create weekly operational reports for administrators to monitor internal performance metrics, and develop separate monthly compliance reports to document safety incidents and training records for regulatory authorities.

query: You are designing a sales dashboard for your organization in Power BI. Your manager wants users to view overall sales data for each salesperson but also be able to expand and see sales by individual shipping providers (such as FedEx, Loomis, and Parcel Post) for each salesperson without navigating away from the dashboard or creating extra visuals. Which approach should you implement to BEST meet these requirements?
response: Add a visual filter to the matrix visual, allowing users to expand or collapse each salesperson row to see associated shipping provider sales within the same visual.

query: You are the IT manager for a company's help desk, which handles customer support calls. Recently, there was a sudden spike in call volume that went unnoticed until end-of-day reports were reviewed. To better manage support resources and quickly address similar incidents in the future, which reporting solution should you implement to effectively apply real-time reporting concepts?
response: Set up a dashboard connected directly to the help desk's call tracking database that updates automatically and displays live call volumes, enabling managers to respond immediately to spikes or trends as they happen.

query: Your team has developed a set of dashboards using Power BI, and they are approved to move into production. Before you deploy, you discover that access will depend on each user having the correct license. What is the BEST action to take to ensure a successful and uninterrupted deployment?
response: Confirm that all intended users have the appropriate licenses assigned for accessing and interacting with the dashboards before deployment.

query: A marketing director requested a report that can be run daily on the intranet. The report must look at the last month of data and compare it to the month-to-date data. What type of report is this?
response: Point-in-time

query: An information technology manager has received a budget to replace all the printers throughout the environment. The manager wants to build a one-time report that shows the existing printers throughout the environment to track them down, but will not need to use it again. What type of report should they use?
response: Ad hoc

query: What is an advantage of using custom visuals as tooltips instead of default text-based tooltips in dashboards?
response: They can display a small chart or detailed breakdown related to the hovered item, helping users spot patterns directly within the tooltip.

query: You are responsible for designing a monthly sales report that will be used by managers at different times throughout the month. The report is scheduled to run on the first day of each month and sometimes is printed or shared as a PDF. Managers often ask whether the data reflects recent updates or changes that happened mid-month. Which system function should you include in your report to BEST address the managers' needs?
response: Display the refresh date/time on the report.

query: A national retail chain is reviewing its business processes after a recent audit highlighted gaps in both the documentation of product returns and adherence to safety guidelines in its warehouses. The company has been generating monthly operational reports on sales trends and inventory turnover, which are regularly reviewed by store managers. However, the compliance officer discovered that reports related to employee safety meetings and workplace incidents were either missing or inconsistent in their data collection methods. As a data analyst, you are asked to assess the current reporting procedures and recommend what should change to ensure more effective operational monitoring and regulatory compliance. Which of the following actions demonstrates the BEST analytical response to address both the operational and compliance issues identified?
response: Evaluate the existing operational report templates to identify which key safety metrics are missing, and design a new compliance report template to ensure consistent documentation of safety meetings and incidents, while continuing the monthly operational reports for business metrics.

query: An IT manager is putting together a presentation. The manager wants to hide items from view when the dashboard is published but also wants the ability to view the information on a hover. What should they set up?
response: Tooltip

query: Imagine you are a data analyst at a retail company. The marketing team often asks for specific customer purchase data, and you usually spend hours compiling custom reports for them each week. The company is considering implementing a self-service reporting dashboard designed for the marketing team. As part of a pilot program, you are asked to recommend how the marketing team should best use the self-service dashboard to address their ongoing data needs. Which action would MOST appropriately demonstrate effective use of self-service reporting?
response: The marketing team learns to use the dashboard tools to independently generate and customize reports with the specific purchase data they need, whenever they need it.

query: A C-level executive for a large corporation is delegating the creation of an annual report to look back on the previous year and the performance measures that have been set. What type of report should they use?
response: Point-in-time

query: You are a data analyst preparing to deploy a new dashboard for your organization. You have already tested the dashboard yourself and are preparing to finalize the deployment process. Which action should you take next to ensure a smooth transition from proof of concept to production, according to best practices?
response: Schedule User Acceptance Testing (UAT) with a group of end users who will interact with the dashboard before final approval and deployment.

query: The admissions committee at a university meets every quarter to evaluate application trends. They want a report showing the number of applications received, broken down by city and state, for each of the past three quarters. The committee will use the report during their meetings to compare application trends over time and make decisions for upcoming recruitment periods. Which reporting approach MOST appropriately applies point-in-time reporting based on their requirements?
response: Prepare a quarterly report that captures a snapshot of application data as of the end of each quarter, comparing the three quarters side-by-side to provide historical perspective for the committee's analysis.

query: A safety manager needs to draft quarterly safety reports to stay in compliance with federal regulations. What is this type of report considered?
response: Recurring

query: Which situation most clearly demonstrates the use of anonymization in accordance with privacy best practices?
response: Grouping individual ages into broad age ranges and replacing all names and addresses with unrelated placeholder values before releasing the data to the public.

query: A logistics company uses a navigation application to track delivery trucks across the country and update routes dynamically based on traffic conditions and driver actions. If a driver takes a wrong turn, the application must immediately generate an updated route to ensure timely delivery, even if the route is only approximately optimal. Which data processing approach best fits this scenario?
response: Real-Time Processing

query: A retail company collects customer purchase information, stores it securely, and regularly uses it to inform marketing strategies. After several years, the company determines that a portion of this data is no longer actively needed but must be retained for compliance reasons. According to the data lifecycle, what is the MOST appropriate next step the company should take with this data?
response: Archive the data to remove it from everyday use while keeping it accessible for compliance purposes.

query: You are a data analyst working with student records for a school district. Your task is to prepare a dataset for a research project that will be shared with an external research team. The dataset contains the following fields: Student Name, Date of Birth, Student ID, Grade Level, and Test Scores. The research project only requires analysis by age groups, grade levels, and test scores. What is the MOST appropriate way to de-identify the data before sharing it?
response: Remove Student Name and Date of Birth, then create age bands (such as 5–7, 8–10, 11–13, etc.) to replace specific ages.

query: You are a data analyst working for a healthcare organization. Your team is tasked with creating a report that tracks employee attendance at mandatory safety meetings to ensure compliance with health and safety regulations such as OSHA. The report will include names, job titles, dates of attendance, and notes about safety incidents discussed. The results will be shared with company leadership and may be submitted to regulators if requested. Which of the following actions BEST demonstrates proper data classification and protection to ensure data privacy when preparing this report?
response: Mark the report as "Confidential—Internal Use Only," remove personally identifiable information where possible, and store the report in a secure, access-controlled environment.

query: You are responsible for securing customer financial information at a multinational e-commerce firm. Your company transfers and stores private data for customers from countries with varying legal requirements regarding encryption. You need to implement an encryption standard that is widely accepted, meets regulatory compliance in many jurisdictions, and safeguards data both in transit and at rest. Which action should you take to ensure your encryption practices comply with international standards and legal requirements for data protection?
response: Implement the Advanced Encryption Standard (AES), as it is FIPS-approved and accepted internationally, while regularly reviewing country-specific laws regarding encryption restrictions.

query: Which of the following is a responsibility of an organization's data governance or compliance team related to jurisdiction requirements?
response: Monitoring applicable local, national, and international data laws that impact how the organization uses data.

query: After a data breach occurs in an organization, what is the MOST important first step according to policy and regulation?
response: Notify the appropriate person or team so they can respond to the situation.

query: A healthcare organization stores large volumes of sensitive patient data, including medical records, on servers located in a secure data center. Recently, an external hard drive containing backup copies of this data was lost. As the organization's data analyst, you need to recommend the best approach to prevent unauthorized access to the data if a similar incident happens again. Which of the following actions should you recommend to protect the backup data at rest in the future?
response: Implement symmetric encryption on all backup files, ensuring only authorized users with the correct key can access the data even if the device is lost.

query: After a company archives its tax records for the required retention period, what should be the organization's next step according to the data lifecycle?
response: Seek authorization to destroy the records in accordance with legal requirements.

query: During a conversation with your IT department, you learn that the legal environment in your country requires all personal information sent over public networks to be protected against unauthorized access. Your company is updating its data transmission processes in response. What is the primary reason encryption should be applied specifically to data in transit?
response: To ensure that even if intercepted, the data cannot be read by unauthorized parties.

query: Which of the following BEST demonstrates an organization operating at an effective level of data governance maturity?
response: The organization has reached its goal of information and data management with transparency, accountability, and standardization.

query: A data analyst at Company X is preparing to transmit sensitive customer data from her workstation to a remote database server over the internet. To ensure the data remains protected during transmission, she must apply an appropriate encryption strategy. What step should she perform at the client side before sending the data to the database server using TLS?
response: Encrypt the data at the client using a master key negotiated during the TLS handshake, then transmit the encrypted data to the server.

query: A city government is releasing traffic accident data to the public for use by researchers and journalists. The original dataset includes license plate numbers, driver names, accident locations, exact timestamps, and injury details. The city wants to ensure individuals involved in accidents cannot be re-identified from the released data. Which approach BEST applies anonymization to this situation?
response: Remove license plate numbers and driver names, group accident times into broad intervals (such as "morning," "afternoon," or "evening"), and generalize accident location to the city district instead of the specific address.

query: A company's IT department recently adopted a new analytics tool that handles both marketing and HR data. To follow security best practices, the company set up role-based permissions in the system. Marketing managers can access HR-related data for all employees in their department, while non-management marketing staff can only view their own HR data. A non-management marketing employee attempts to view the HR records of a fellow team member using the company's new analytics tool but is denied access. What is the most likely reason the employee is denied access to this data?
response: TThe employee's role on the system only allows them to access their own HR data, not others' HR data.

query: You are working as a data analyst for a healthcare organization. One afternoon, you realize that a report you shared with an external contractor accidentally includes a column with patients' full names and addresses. The contractor is not authorized to view this information, and you are unsure whether they have already accessed the file. What is the MOST appropriate action for you to take next?
response: Immediately escalate the incident by formally reporting it to your organization's designated data breach response team or individual, following all required internal protocols for incident response.

query: A marketing team at a retail company must work with another retail company to come up with a synergistic way to promote products together. They want to share helpful information which will help the marketing campaign without giving out any personal identifiable information or information they should not. What would be the best way to do this? (Select all that apply.)
response: Banding
Masking
Aggregating

query: What is the primary risk associated with failing to encrypt data at rest?
response: Stored data can be accessed by unauthorized individuals if storage devices are lost or stolen.

query: A marketing analyst at TechSolutions is collaborating with an external data consulting firm. They want to share customer purchasing data with the firm so it can provide insights and recommendations. Both parties want to outline how the data will be used and clarify expectations, but they do not want to create a legally binding contract at this stage. Which type of agreement should the analyst recommend to best address these needs?
response: Memorandum of Understanding (MOU)

query: You have been assigned to work on a team project that involves regularly updating a large spreadsheet with confidential client information. The team is distributed across multiple locations, and you need to ensure everyone has access to the latest version of the file, version history is tracked, and company policies on security and backup are followed. What is the BEST method to save and manage this file?
response: Save the spreadsheet to a secure company cloud drive and configure access only for authorized team members.

query: A company, Acme Analytics, is partnering with a third-party marketing vendor to analyze its customer purchase data. Acme wants to allow the vendor to review transaction records to identify shopping trends, but it must prevent the vendor from using any of this data to build a separate client database for marketing to those same customers. Which data use agreement is MOST appropriate for clearly defining and enforcing how the vendor can and cannot use the customer data?
response: Acceptable Use Agreement

query: A company replaces customer names in a dataset with random strings of numbers and letters, and stores the key linking these pseudonyms to actual names in a different, secure database. What is the effect of this process on the risk of exposure if only the pseudonymized data is leaked?
response: The risk of exposing individual identities is significantly reduced, but not completely eliminated.

query: A US-based technology services firm wants to expand its operations by providing data analysis services for several companies located in the European Union. These services involve the transfer of EU customer data to the firm's data centers in the United States. The firm's management is concerned about complying with international standards for data privacy and protection, specifically when transferring personal data from the EU to the US. To address the transfer of personal data from EU companies to its US data centers in a compliant manner, what should the US-based firm do according to the Privacy Shield framework?
response: Self-certify under the Privacy Shield framework to demonstrate adequate safeguards for EU personal data transferred to the US.

query: A marketing team is expanding the business into a new country. The team wants to research the laws governing the country where the data is stored and find how much control that country has over data collected by businesses. What should the team research?
response: Sovereignty

query: You are a data analyst for a school district implementing a new Student Information System. As part of the data governance team, you’re tasked with ensuring that information about students, classes, and teachers is organized to help both reporting and security. The team uses entity relationship models to visualize and document relationships. For effective governance, they want to clearly represent which entities are at the top level, and how the hierarchy is structured—so that, for instance, students can be connected with classes under teachers, and data classification can be applied correctly. Which of the following approaches best uses entity relationship models to document and apply hierarchy structure, supporting secure and accurate data reporting?
response: Create an entity relationship diagram where "Teachers" are at the top, with "Classes" connected below, and "Students" connected to each class. Apply data classification and user access controls at each entity level according to its position in the hierarchy.

query: When an organization is not subject to external data retention regulations, which factor should primarily influence its decision on retaining data?
response: The costs associated with storing and maintaining unneeded data.

query: When preparing a data report that must include student ID numbers, which approach BEST utilizes value masking to protect personally identifiable information?
response: Show only the last four digits of each student ID number, masking the others with asterisks.

query: Your organization recently experienced a security incident where unauthorized users accessed sensitive data stored on a company server. After the incident, the data governance team must ensure this does not happen again. Which of the following actions should the Data Custodian take as part of their responsibility?
response: Implement and enforce stricter access controls and update backup/recovery measures on the affected server.

query: A healthcare organization needs to exchange patient data among clinics that use various software platforms. In one example, a clinic receives a data file containing patient records. Each record is clearly labeled with tags like <patientName>, <appointmentDate>, and <diagnosis>. The clinic's software processes these files by reading the tags and extracting specific fields, regardless of the order or number of fields present in each record. Which data format is allowing the clinics to flexibly extract the needed information from the data file?
response: XML

query: Maria is a data analyst at a retail company. Her manager has asked her to create interactive dashboards to track daily sales, visualize trends, and share the dashboards with department heads so they can filter the data based on different product categories and time periods. The company wants to use a tool that is specifically designed for business intelligence, supports robust data visualization, and is widely used in industry for creating and sharing dashboards. Which tool should Maria recommend to best meet these requirements?
response: Tableau

query:
A data analyst receives two JSON data files from different sources, each containing product inventory for a warehouse.
The analyst needs to determine which file allows for easier extraction of the total number of "soup" bowls in stock throughout all categories by a programming script.
File 1:
{ "warehouse": "WarehouseOnChestnut", "categories": [ { "name": "Bowls", "items": [ { "id": "B100", "name": "soup", "stock": 35 }, { "id": "B101", "name": "salad", "stock": 30 } ] }, { "name": "Plates", "items": [ { "id": "P200", "name": "dinner", "stock": 45 } ] } ] }
File 2:
{ "warehouse": "WarehouseOnChestnut", "inventory": [ { "type": "bowl", "description": "soup", "amount": "35" }, { "type": "bowl", "description": "salad", "amount": "30" }, { "type": "plate", "description": "dinner", "amount": "45" } ] }
Which file provides a structure that supports more efficient analysis for summing all "soup" bowls across the warehouse, and why?
response: File 2, because the inventory information is in a flat array where each item's type, description, and quantity can be directly accessed and filtered.

query: A data scientist is working on a new, severely underfunded research project. The project aims to create a program that accepts tidal height information and moon phase information to perform calculations to build charts and graphs to find common and obscure correlations between the different data sets. Why is Python the data scientist's programming language of choice for this project?
response: It is open source

query: Which view in Power BI allows a user to explore data in a spreadsheet type of view?
response: Data view

query:
A developer wants to send purchase order data from an inventory system to a shipping system and needs to include fields that the shipping system can recognize and extract, such as <orderDate>, <productID>, and <shippingAddress>.
Which option BEST represents how XML would be used in this scenario?
response: By wrapping each relevant piece of data in custom tags named for its contents.

query: A data analyst is developing a report on quarterly sales figures for each of the company’s product types and wants product managers to see the data related only to their products. Since the analyst does not have permissions to create a view in the database, how can they accomplish this task?
response: Use Power BI.

query: A financial analyst is in the process of analyzing and reporting on the revenue and expenses of a large corporation. The analyst uses Power BI and Power Query to help with data analysis. What benefits do these tools offer in this scenario?
response: Power Query is a data transformation tool that allows analysts to merge, clean, and transform data from different sources, while Power BI is a data visualization tool that provides interactive and dynamic reports and dashboards.
